data.content:
## [Customer service said no to replacement slats](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a58215384438fe546b3f323)
Ordered a King Size Ginny MacDonald Lockwood Bed in Talc Performance Linen ($3,998 pre tax, shipping) approximately 1.5 years ago. Although we had moderate issues with delivery and installation at the time the order was made, the reason for my 1 star review today is that several of the support slats (the only means of support under the mattress) have completely failed and are no longer usable only 1.5 years into our ownership. Given the product's life that would seemingly suggest either a defect or low overall quality. When we contacted lulu and georgia support, their response was that the product is no longer under warranty and they suggested we "find a local carpenter" to fashion replacement slats. Look, I completely understand the product no longer being under warranty and I also understand a Company's hesitancy to replace an entire product due to the immense cost; however, the slats are the cheapest component of the entire bedframe (particle board and wooden block attached via cheap metal fastener). Sure I could go out and probably get the materials myself at Home Depot, but that's not the point. It would seem to me to be no brainer customer service decision on a $4k+ item to replace a couple simple slats. Now, I'm certainly not going to recommend lulu and georgia products to anyone given my suspicions about poor quality and lack of creative customer service solutions.

July 13, 2026

Unprompted review
